name: Energy Manipulation
description: Energy Manipulation allows you to channel energy to deliver deadly blows. These powers also help you focus your power to increase your own abilities.

powers.name: Power Thrust
powers.description: A focused attack that violently shoves the target and sends them flying. Deals minimal damage, but can be very effective. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Energy Punch
powers.description: Powerful focused punch that may Disorient your opponent! Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Bone Smasher
powers.description: The Bone Smasher is a slow attack, but makes up for it with a good amount of damage. Has a greater chance to Disorient than Energy Punch. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Energize
powers.description: You can channel a tremendous amount of energy through your body for a short period of time.  Doing so will heal some hit points, reduce the endurance cost of your powers and boost your regeneration dramatically for a short time.  Recharge: Very Long

powers.name: Staggering Burst
powers.description: You focus an unstable shot of energy in your hands, dealing a hefty amount of damage to your target.  The unstable nature of the attack causes it to burst out, hitting enemies around the target.  While the initial target has a high chance to stun your target, the burst only has a moderate chance to stun ancillary targets.  Damage: High, Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Power Boost
powers.description: Greatly boosts the secondary effects of your powers. Your powers effects like Heals, Defense Buffs, Endurance Drains, Disorients, Holds, Immobilizes, Knockbacks and more, are all improved. The effects of Power Boost last a short while, and only the next couple of attacks will be boosted. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Boost Range
powers.description: You can boost your powers to increase the range of your next few attacks. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Total Focus
powers.description: Total Focus is complete mastery over Energy Melee. This is a very slow, but incredibly devastating attack that can knock out most opponents, leaving them Disoriented. Due to the exhausting nature of Total Focus, recharge time is very long. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Long
